Name: Nekromeowncer's Portraits (Base game and SVE)
Author: Nekromeowncer
Description:
I decided to make my own set of portraits for Stardew Valley. They are in png format and made to be used with Portraiture. Up to date with 1.5. This is a complete set. It has all the characters as of 1.5. Some of the characters have extra options. If you want to use them, you'll have to rename the file you want to use to the name it's supposed to have. (ex: HarveyNoMoustache to Harvey) I have turned all the non-human characters into humanoids. I have used the design by Chikael at the following link as a couple of the options for the wizard. [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226[/url] All credit goes to them for the design. 

I updated this so you can either use it with base game OR base game and Stardew Valley Expanded. You only need to download one of the files, not both. There are some options for the wizard in both files that have 9 expressions for Romanceable Rasmodius. There are also some genderbend versions of the bachelorettes if you want to turn the game into an otome basically lol. Note: This does not change the pronouns or names of the bachelorettes in game. You will need an additional mod like the one linked below to do that. It also does not change their walksprites to match their portraits so I would recommend finding a mod for that as well.

Stardew Valley Expanded: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753[/url]
Romanceable Rasmodius: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073[/url]
SVE Compatible Romanceable Rasmodius: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000
[/url]Ultimate Villager Manager (Can use to change npc pronouns and names): [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271[/url]

Downloads.Description: The complete set of portraits for Stardew Valley 1.5 .
Includes base game portraits and Stardew Valley Expanded character's portraits.

Genderbend versions of the bachelorettes from base game. This does *not* change the pronouns they are referred to with in-game, nor the walksprites. Only the portraits. You will need additional mods to change those things.
